primary_title: Granulocyte macrophage colony-stimulating factor induces CCL17 production via IRF4 to mediate inflammation
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows GM-CSF upregulates IRF4 expression in human monocytes and murine macrophages as part of the pathway leading to CCL17 formation.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded GM-CSF/CSF2-associated IRF4 gene-expression bridge upstream of CCL17 output; preserve the JMJD3/IRF4 mechanism and myeloid context without treating IRF4 as a terminal target.

primary_title: Granulocyte macrophage colony-stimulating factor induces CCL17 production via IRF4 to mediate inflammation
decision_basis: The review-guided primary identifies CCL17/TARC as the most highly upregulated chemokine gene after GM-CSF treatment of human monocytes and confirms induction in murine macrophages.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded GM-CSF/CSF2-to-CCL17/TARC gene-expression bridge; keep it distinct from the separately materialized CCL17 protein-release node and preserve IRF4/JMJD3 and myeloid context.

primary_title: Granulocyte macrophage colony-stimulating factor induces CCL17 production via IRF4 to mediate inflammation
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows high-level CCL17 protein in supernatants from GM-CSF-treated human monocytes and murine macrophages, measured by immunoassay.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded GM-CSF/CSF2-to-secreted CCL17 protein-release bridge; preserve the distinct gene-versus-protein semantics and do not infer an unqualified downstream CCL17 receptor edge or SCI relevance.
